Bundled text preview dependencies (no CDN or runtime network dependency):

marked 18.1.3 — https://github.com/markedjs/marked — MIT, see marked-LICENSE.
DOMPurify 3.4.17 — https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify — Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0,
see DOMPurify-LICENSE. Used under Apache-2.0.

Exact npm versions and integrity values are pinned in package-lock.json.
Copy sources: marked/lib/marked.umd.js and dompurify/dist/purify.min.js.
Markdown formatting runs in a bounded worker; HTML is sanitized before display.
